property_summary: After any successful 10-ether call to the fallback in block N at timestamp T, a second 10-ether call in a later block at a strictly greater timestamp must also succeed (timestamp strictly increases); the mutant stores block.number instead, so it wrongly rejects the second call whenever the block number exceeds the new timestamp.
change_summary: Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value is a block number instead of a timestamp.
